title: A Moveable Feast
author: Ernest Hemingway
summary: Hemingway recalls his early years as a struggling writer in 1920s Paris, with sketches of cafes, hunger, his first wife, and fellow writers including Fitzgerald and Gertrude Stein.
readIf: you love literary history and atmospheric writing about Paris.
skipIf: you want a reliable, complete autobiography and not a polished, selective recollection.
